subject: mathematics

sections.scope_note: Arizona standards deferred. This crosswalk covers Florida B.E.S.T. Mathematics (2026) and IB PYP only. Rows are suggested (Label C).

rows.topic_domain: Place value of decimals to the thousandths
ib_framework_elements: PYP Mathematics: Number (strand name reused from grade 3)
PYP concept: Form (name reused from grade 3)
rows.key_differences: Florida sets how a digit's value changes by place, read/write/compose/compare to the thousandths, and rounding to the nearest hundredth, tenth, or whole number. IB does not publish those limits on the public pages.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Build, compare, and round decimal quantities that come up in a unit (measurements or money) and say what the place shift does to the value.

rows.topic_domain: Multi-digit operations with whole numbers and decimals
ib_framework_elements: PYP Mathematics: Number (strand name reused from grade 3)
rows.key_differences: Florida distinguishes procedural fluency with a standard algorithm for multi-digit multiplication, division with fractional remainders, and decimal addition and subtraction, and it treats decimal multiplication and division as exploration or reliability. Those fluency labels are Florida's.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Solve a multiplication or division situation from the inquiry and have the student explain the method, including what a remainder means.

rows.topic_domain: Fractions as division and fraction operations
ib_framework_elements: PYP Mathematics: Number (strand name reused from grade 3)
PYP concept: Function (name reused from grade 3)
rows.key_differences: Florida represents division of whole numbers as a fraction, adds and subtracts unlike denominators, multiplies a fraction by a fraction, predicts the size of a product, and explores division with unit fractions. Those operation limits are Florida's.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Share a quantity from the inquiry equally, write the share as a fraction, and predict whether multiplying by a fraction less than 1 will make the result smaller.

rows.topic_domain: Multi-step problems with whole numbers and fractions
ib_framework_elements: PYP learning in context (public: subject-specific learning within units of inquiry)
rows.key_differences: Florida includes interpreting remainders and real-world fraction operations, including division of a unit fraction by a whole number and the reverse. The public PYP page does not set those problem types.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Pose one inquiry problem that needs more than one operation and decide what a remainder means in that situation.

rows.topic_domain: Expressions, order of operations, and equations
ib_framework_elements: PYP Mathematics: Number (strand name reused from grade 3)
rows.key_differences: Florida asks students to translate descriptions and expressions, evaluate with order of operations, judge equations true or false, and write an equation for an unknown whole number. Clarifications exclude exponents and nested grouping symbols. Public PYP text does not.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Write an expression for an inquiry situation, evaluate it, and say whether a related equation is true.

ib_framework_elements: PYP Mathematics: Pattern and function (strand name reused from grade 3)
rows.key_differences: Florida asks for a rule as an expression and a two-column input-output table, with rules limited to one or two operations on whole numbers in the clarification. That is not a published IB grade 5 outcome.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Record inputs and outputs from a repeating inquiry pattern and write one rule that fits the table.

ib_framework_elements: PYP Mathematics: Measurement (strand name reused from grade 3)
rows.key_differences: Florida requires multi-step conversions within one system, including length, time, volume, and capacity, and multi-step money problems in decimal notation, without expecting memorized conversions. Those constraints are Florida's.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Convert a measurement that the inquiry actually uses, staying inside one system, and compare two money amounts written as decimals.

ib_framework_elements: PYP Mathematics: Shape and space (strand name reused from grade 3)
PYP concept: Form (name reused from grade 3)
rows.key_differences: Florida classifies triangles and quadrilaterals by shared attributes and limits three-dimensional figures to right pyramids, right prisms, right circular cylinders, right circular cones, and spheres. PYP shape work is not limited to that list on the public pages.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Sort figures from the environment and explain why one shape does or does not belong in a category.

ib_framework_elements: PYP Mathematics: Measurement (strand name reused from grade 3)
PYP Mathematics: Shape and space (strand name reused from grade 3)
rows.key_differences: Florida finds perimeter and area of rectangles with fractional or decimal sides, explores volume by packing unit cubes, and then uses a formula, including an unknown edge. That teaching sequence is not an IB rule.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Pack a right rectangular prism from the inquiry with unit cubes, then check the count with a formula and name the units in words.

rows.topic_domain: Coordinate plane in the first quadrant
ib_framework_elements: PYP Mathematics: Shape and space (strand name reused from grade 3)
PYP concept: Connection (name reused from grade 3)
rows.key_differences: Florida identifies the origin and axes and plots and interprets ordered pairs of whole numbers in the first quadrant. Public PYP pages do not name the coordinate plane.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Plot two inquiry measurements as a point in the first quadrant and say what each coordinate means.

rows.topic_domain: Data displays and mean, mode, median, or range
ib_framework_elements: PYP Mathematics: Data handling (strand name reused from grade 3)
rows.key_differences: Florida collects numerical data, including fractions and decimals, in tables, line graphs, or line plots, and interprets whole-number data by mean, mode, median, or range. Public PYP text names research skills, not those measures.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Collect one set of inquiry data, display it, and state the mean or range in the context.

version_notes: 2026-10-03: Grade 5 FL↔IB crosswalk. Arizona left empty (deferred). Rows are suggested alignments (Label C). Florida IDs are from the grade 5 drafts. IB elements are either public PYP framework text or the same strand labels used in the grade 2 and grade 3 crosswalks. No IB learning outcomes were invented.
